profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at SS8
profile.summary:
Accomplished software professional with 10+ of development experience. Enjoys applying creativity and innovation by developing software to solve business problems.

Experienced with the following programming languages and software technologies:
- Python, Java, GoLang, ReactJS, NodeJS, Groovy, JavaScript/Typescript, C, BASH, SQL, Cypher
- Relational, Non-Relational, and Graph Databases
- Amazon Web Services(AWS DynamoDB, Lambda, EC2, ECS, EKS, SQS, and more), Google Cloud(GCP), Azure
- Docker, Kubernetes, Neo4j, Apache Kafka
- GitHub, GitHub Enterprise, Gitlab, Jira, Git, Visual Studio Code, IntelliJ IDEA, Jenkins
- HTML, JSON, XML, REST, JVM, HTTP

Possesses an excellent aptitude for written and verbal communication, public speaking, and cross–functional collaboration

Experienced with all phases of the software development life cycle(SDLC), agile & waterfall development methodologies, test-driven development(TDD), pair programming, cloud software, graphical user interface(GUI) design, digital security, virtualization, backup and restore software, object oriented design, multi-threaded programming, engineering of data structures & algorithms, optimization of software for performance, unit testing, system testing, and functional testing

Licensed with the US Patent and Trademark Office(USPTO) as a Patent Agent, and familiar of the patent procurement process as well as the international procedures under the Patent Cooperation Treaty

volunteerExperiences.role: Canvaser for IBM Employee Contribution Charitable Campaign(ECCC)
volunteerExperiences.description:
Assumed responsibility as a canvasser for the IBM Employee Contribution Charitable Campaign (ECCC) for three consecutive years, where I raised awareness of several charitable causes such as cancer and other birth defects.
I achieved  my goal of a 100 percent participation rate from my team each year, in obtaining aid for these charitable causes
